notes.title: Take an emotional trip through the mind in Into A Dream out now
notes.notes: Into A Dream is a brand new release from indie developer Filipe F. Thomaz, telling a tale about diving into the mind of someone diagnosed with severe depression.

notes.title: Into A Dream is OUT NOW
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Into A Dream has just been released and is available alongside its OST! :D
Thank you,

Filipe

notes.title: Into A Dream Releases in 5 days! - July 30th
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!,

Into A Dream is releasing on the 30th of July! Less than a week to go!

It's an emotionally charged story game that plays out inside the dreams of Luke Williams, a man diagnosed with depression. 

This has been an amazing journey, started in late February of 2019, when I decided to develop this game by myself. Despite all the challenges my passion for this project was stronger and here I am announcing the release of Into A Dream. I hope its story may resonate with you.

Have a lovely week everyone,

Filipe

notes.title: Teaming Up with CheckPoint Organization!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!,

We are proud to inform that Into A Dream has teamed up with CheckPoint, an organization providing mental health resources for gamers! -  https://checkpointorg.com

Into A Dream's crowdfunding campaign, live until the 3rd of July -https://www.indiegogo.com/projects/into-a-dream/x/2357819/ - includes a new specific tier in which 25% of your contribution will be donated to CheckPoint. In return you will get various rewards, including a copy of Into A Dream (Win, Mac, Linux), a short-story "The Lighthouse" connected to the game and mental health, as well as CheckPoint's Digital Coping Companion, a set of 50 high quality, illustrated digital cards containing over fifty evidence based tips for dealing with everyday stress and anxiety, as well as crises, distress and panic symptoms.

You may still choose one of the different perks in the crowdfunding campaign, and then select The Digital Coping Companion as an add-on, whose entire value, after removing transaction and the platform fees, will be donated to CheckPoint!

Go check it out on Into A Dream's Indiegogo crowdfunding campaign - https://www.indiegogo.com/projects/into-a-dream/x/2357819/ - and let's continue to be a voice in raising awareness for mental health! 

Thank you so much to CheckPoint for the opportunity, and to every single one of you for taking the time to read this,
I wish you a fantastic day,

Filipe
